Clinical_signs: EASI-50 at 3 months; EASI-75 or EASI ≤7 at 6 months
Patient_reported_targets: Itch decrease ≥3 at 3 months; PP-NRS ≤4 at 6 months. DLQI decrease ≥4 then ≤5; POEM decrease ≥4 then ≤7
Additional_requirements: PtGA decrease ≥1 then ≤2; treatment choices also consider safety and tolerability
Applicability_to_this_cohort: Can reproduce individual EASI/itch/DLQI components, but full algorithm requires verified PtGA

Applicability_to_this_cohort: Only measured domains can be reproduced; missing ADCT/POEM prevents full framework emulation
Verification: Original Chinese full text unavailable in this search; thresholds checked against 2026 publication by guidance authors, Table 1

Decision_logic: Patient chooses priority features; clinician selects ≥1 clinical measure; optimal agreed targets define MDA
Clinical_signs: Examples: EASI-90 or EASI ≤3; alternatively IGA 0/1 plus BSA ≤2%
Patient_reported_targets: If selected: itch ≤1, DLQI 0/1, POEM ≤2, sleep ≤1, pain ≤1; mental health has separate targets
Additional_requirements: Patient priorities determine selected targets; this is not one universal fixed composite
Applicability_to_this_cohort: Can report a prespecified EASI-and-itch operationalization, not full individualized AHEAD attainment without chosen-priority records

Timing: Immediate <4 weeks; short term 3–6 months; long term ≥1 year
Decision_logic: Shared targets; clear/almost-clear skin and minimal itch
Clinical_signs: Aspire to EASI-90 or EASI ≤3 at 4–6 months
Patient_reported_targets: Pruritus NRS ≤1 and DLQI ≤3 at 4–6 months
Additional_requirements: Long-term goals include sustained control, fewer flares and reduced topical steroid use
Applicability_to_this_cohort: Endpoint components measurable; durability and patient priorities require additional longitudinal records

Timing: Single-visit LDA/vLDA; ≥6 months on-drug control; ≥12 months off-drug remission
Clinical_signs: EASI branch: LDA ≤7; vLDA ≤3; complete-control/remission threshold EASI =0
Patient_reported_targets: PP-NRS ≤4 for LDA; ≤1 for vLDA and control/remission
Additional_requirements: A single visit meeting clear-skin thresholds does not establish complete control or remission
Applicability_to_this_cohort: Use EASI branch plus itch; sparse Week 0/12/24 visits cannot establish continuous 6-month control or 12-month off-drug remission
Verification: Primary abstract verified; local IGA should not be silently treated as validated vIGA-AD
